approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Reaches the Minigame Tent and Free Play Arcade; the pointer follows the remote at once. The European disc runs at 50 Hz, as on a real Wii (it has no 60 Hz mode). Tested on Windows 11 by playing into the first real scene; on the Linux mini PC through the title to the file select. Known problem on the mini PC: after a save file was chosen the game once stopped responding (memory faults in the log); not yet reproduced or explained. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
